android_mechanism: List rows eagerly created / not recycled while scrolling
bug_description: The song search-result tab renders results with a plain ForEach inside List. Loading several result pages (30 per page) eagerly creates SongCard components for every accumulated result — including off-screen ones — and rebuilds them as the array grows, slowing search-result display and scrolling.
fix_summary: Results render through LazyForEach backed by a LazyData data source (already used elsewhere in the app), so rows are created on demand and recycled.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

mechanism_oracle.definition: (a) UI-thread CPU from results display to end of scroll; (b) count of SongCard component builds; (c) dropped frames while scrolling.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed builds all accumulated rows (150+ after 5 pages) at once; fixed builds only visible rows. unfixed first-paint after load-more and scroll CPU measurably higher; more jank frames.

reproduction: git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_search_result_foreach/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_search_result_foreach/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
